tracks.theme: Mid-July peak green - the Dal glass-still at dawn, Mughal gardens in full bloom, Gulmarg's meadows carpeted with wildflowers while the plains bake
tracks.subject: July in Kashmir is deep green and wide awake

tracks.theme: Peak-July loss-aversion - Kashmir full of travellers searching rooms now; the hotel that is listed gets booked, the unlisted one loses the guest next door
tracks.subject: Peak July nights are booking every stay but yours

tracks.theme: Yatra-week rides and loss-aversion - airport runs, valley drives and golden-hour shikaras booking all day; an idle cab or boat loses the fare to a listed one
tracks.subject: A July airport run just went to a listed cab
